content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue connecting my [product_name] [version_no] to AWS. The device registration in [product_name] was completed, but when I test the connection to AWS servers, I receive an error message. This was split from a thread about cloud test connection failures.

Hello, I'm having trouble connecting my [product_name] [version_no] to AWS cloud. The 'thing' was registered in [product_name], but when I attempt the test connection to the cloud, an error message appears. What steps can I take? Thanks in advance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face difficulties establishing connections between their [product_name] [version_no] controllers and AWS cloud services, even after successful device registration in [product_name]. The connection attempt fails with an unclear error message, suggesting a gap between setup and actual cloud connectivity. This highlights a need for better error communication and support resources.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple cloud setup experience with clear instructions and error messages that facilitate troubleshooting and successful connection.
